items.prompt: A backtest changes latency, fees and partial-fill policy but keeps the signal fixed. Why?

options.text: To prove the most profitable scenario is true
To verify the signal is independent of execution assumptions without rerunning outcomes
options.why: That independence is not guaranteed. Rerunning execution scenarios measures the resulting sensitivity.

options.text: To test sensitivity to execution assumptions
options.why: Signal performance can depend strongly on fills/costs.

items.explanation: Separate strategy logic from the uncertain execution model.
